state.background: Review the provisional Plan39 V2 production correction and its updated Other-share jump threshold. Category baseline[t,c]=B[t,c]*A[2017,c]/B[2017,c] for nine major categories and Other (Other is derived from total less nine majors where missing). Category endpoint coefficient gamma[c]=(A[2025,c]-baseline[2025,c])/(piJan[2025]-piJan[2017]). For 2005-2016, corrected[t,c]=baseline[t,c]+gamma[c]*(piIV4[t]-piIV4[2017]); total is the sum of corrected categories. Official A from 2017 onward passes through unchanged. The residual jump metric is abs(change in 100*Other/total) in percentage points. Its raw official-A maximum over all 8 pairs from 2017->18 through 2024->25 is 0.763941940412554 pp. The dynamic threshold is ceil(rawMaximum*100)/100 = 0.77 pp (round upward to next 0.01 pp), and diagnostics retain both values. The 20 adjacent pairs from 2005->06 through 2024->25 all pass; 2016->17 changes 0.7661764640058344 pp and passes 0.77. Current input-matched publication gate is accepted=true/status=pass with no blocking reasons.
acceptanceCriteria: Threshold is derived from official A share changes only, then dynamically rounded upward by ceil(raw maximum * 100)/100; estimated jumps do not affect threshold derivation.
All 20 adjacent pairs are tested using the same effective threshold; an exceeded or unevaluable required pair closes publication.
Household-share input is manifest/hash validated; 2011 is identified as synthetic interpolation from unverified 2010/2012 endpoints.
Category-specific endpoint correction remains additive; category gamma sum reconciles with independently computed total gamma and total equals category sum.
Only 2005-2016 values are estimated; 2017 onward preserves official A unchanged.
The endpoint calibration uses the saved nominal B/A annual JSON precision of one decimal, disclosed in artifacts and diagnostics.
The 2018-2024 metrics are explicitly retrospective because 2025 is used for calibration, and are not represented as independent forecast or causal evidence.
Current manifest, source hashes, artifact hash, and analysis input fingerprint match.
verification: Latest result records raw threshold max 0.763941940412554, effective threshold 0.77, 8/8 official pairs evaluable, and 20/20 adjacent pair thresholdPass=true with no failed jumps.
2016->2017 Other-share jump is 0.7661764640058344 percentage points and thresholdPass=true under effective 0.77.
Publication gate accepted=true, status=pass, reasonCodes=[], blockingReasonCodes=[].

Category-to-total endpoint gamma discrepancy is 3.268496584496461e-13; maximum historical total/category reconciliation error is 0.

OpenSpec and README document the dynamic ceiling rule, raw/effective values, all-pass boundary, one-decimal precision, 2011 synthetic status, and retrospective limitation. No tests were run for this audit.
knownConstraints: This is a provisional predictive correction; the 2018-2024 comparison is in-sample retrospectively calibrated using 2025 and does not prove causality or independent forecasting performance.
Historical IV-4 and January setai-n shares are different source/vintage definitions; centering at 2017 does not establish a validated bridge.
2011 remains synthetic/unverified and must not be misrepresented as observed.
Assess both mathematical rule and fail-closed implementation; do not infer that passing the rounded threshold validates causality or independent predictive accuracy.
state.outputRequirement: Choose one listed choice. For any non-pass, provide a case-specific finding, affected file/requirement, observed evidence, and either a concrete proposed fix or exact additional evidence needed. Do not invent details.

implementation.instructions: Does the supplied evidence support the implementation against the stated threshold and provisional correction criteria? Return a probability distribution over the listed choices.

criteria.valid_as_defined: The supplied evidence supports acceptance as defined.
criteria.requirements_mismatch: Requirements conflict with intended behavior; identify the requirement and correction.
criteria.missing_prerequisites_info: Prerequisite information is missing; identify exactly what is needed.
criteria.incomplete_implementation_info: Implementation information is incomplete; identify missing details or evidence.
criteria.implementation_issue: An implementation issue exists; identify its location, evidence, and correction.
criteria.scope_violation: The proposal exceeds or falls outside the agreed scope; identify the boundary and adjustment.
criteria.other: A material concern does not fit the categories; identify its location, evidence, and fix or needed evidence.
criteria.indeterminate: The supplied context cannot support a judgment; identify missing context if possible.
